remarks: Welcome Home to The Chesterfield! Discover this exceptional updated end-unit townhouse tucked away at the end of a quiet lane in The Chesterfield-one of Stamford's most sought-after gated communities. Enjoy resort-style living with two in-ground pools, a clubhouse, 24-hour security, and beautifully landscaped grounds. Step inside this immaculate home and you'll find a bright, open Living/Dining Room with gleaming hardwood floors, a cozy wood-burning fireplace, and sliders leading to a private deck overlooking lush lawns and mature landscaping. The updated eat-in kitchen features abundant cabinetry, granite countertops, all-new Frigidaire black stainless steel appliances, new garden/atrium windows, and stylish honeycomb shades. A renovated powder room completes the main level. Upstairs, retreat to the expansive primary suite with hardwood floors, two walk-in closets, and a spa-like marble bath with double sinks, Jacuzzi tub, and stall shower. A spacious second bedroom offers hardwood floors, an en-suite bath, and a wall of closets. The flexible third-floor loft is perfect as a guest room, home office, or studio. The lower level includes a family room with radiant heated tile flooring, sliders to a private patio, laundry, and direct access to the attached one-car garage. This special home combines comfort and convenience-just a short walk to shopping, dining, gyms, and parks, minutes from vibrant downtown Stamford, and only 8 minutes to the train.
